item.title: Flyadeal to Squeeze More Flying From its Fleet to Fuel Expansion
item.description: Flyadeal's CEO believes the airline has seen the worst of the aircraft delivery delays, but engine reliability and spare parts shortages remain a concern.

item.title: Activists Target Hilton CEO’s Home Over ICE Housing
item.description: Targeting a CEO’s home marks a new phase in the anti-ICE campaign — and a reminder that hotel groups now face reputational risks in an ever-more politicized moment.

item.title: America’s Vacation Was Built on Gluttony. Ozempic Killed the Buzz.
item.description: For decades, the travel industry has been an economy of excess — of eating more, drinking more, spending more. But blockbuster weight-loss drugs are now reshaping consumer behavior at a population level, and with it, how travel dollars flow.

item.title: American Airlines Flight Attendants Issue No-Confidence Vote in CEO Robert Isom
item.description: American Airlines once pitched a patient turnaround under Robert Isom. Now, with unions escalating pressure and results lagging rivals, the CEO is on the defensive.

item.title: Dubai’s Flying Taxis Will Start With Airports, Resorts, and Business Districts
item.description: Issues we're watching: When will rates come down and will weight restrictions that limit luggage keep potential customers away?

item.title: MGM Now Powers All Its Las Vegas Strip Properties with Solar. Here’s How
item.description: MGM’s Las Vegas’ solar deal shows how rapidly improving tech and long-term power contracts are turning renewables from a sustainability upgrade into a mainstream tool for cost control and risk management.

item.title: Budget Hotels Are Struggling. Wyndham’s CEO Sees Opportunity
item.description: Wyndham holds about 30% of all U.S. branded economy hotels. CEO Geoff Ballotti said in an exclusive Skift interview that he's optimistic for the budget segment, despite the recent cost and demand pressures it's faced.

item.title: OpenAI Launches Ads Pilot for ChatGPT, Travel Expected to Participate
item.description: OpenAI has crossed the advertising threshold. ChatGPT is now a potential marketing channel for travel brands — one that could surface hotel and flight ads at the exact moment a traveler is planning a trip inside a conversation.

item.title: The Park Hotels is Cutting Rooms to Add Ballrooms
item.description: In India’s big cities, hotels are increasingly being designed around ballrooms rather than beds. Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels’ decision to cut room count in Kolkata to expand banqueting and conference space shows how weddings and corporate events are becoming the primary drivers of profitability.

item.title: Klook’s ‘Chief Spring Officer’ Role Signals a Deeper Bet on Creator-Led Travel Booking
item.description: When a travel company announces a “Chief Spring Officer,” it sounds like a gimmick, but Klook’s experiment reflects how platforms are trying close the gap between inspiration and booking. If this works, similar seasonal roles could emerge around major events.
